hook: Elvis's catalog faces a $48.6 million AI theft nightmare by Anthropic.

sections.voiceover: Authentic Brands Group sued Anthropic using 274 Elvis songs to train its AI. The filing alleges the move violated copyright law by stripping lyric credits. Will Anthropic face the $48.6 million damages the suit seeks?
But the case seeks over $48.6 million, dwarfing typical AI lawsuits.
A court win could force Anthropic to pay $48.6 million. That would be the biggest AI‑music copyright payout ever. It pushes the industry to reconsider training on protected songs.
The $48.6 million claim still hangs in court.
